summary.title: OCC-RAG: Optimal Cognitive Core for Faithful Question Answering

details: Context QA requires answers derived strictly from supplied passages, but LLMs tend to fall back on parametric knowledge, hallucinate under counterfactual/conflicting evidence, and fail to abstain when evidence is missing.
Claim under test: for such tasks reasoning structure matters more than parametric knowledge capacity, so a small task-specialized model should suffice.

OCC-RAG: released 0.6B and 1.7B small language models obtained by mid-training (SFT) a base LM to emit a structured, citation-grounded trace (Query Analysis / Source Analysis / Reasoning / explicit ANSWERABLE-UNANSWERABLE Status / Answer) instead of a free-form answer.

A synthetic corpus generation pipeline that jointly targets multi-hop reasoning, context faithfulness, and calibrated abstention; its distinctive component generates multi-hop questions by sampling explicit reasoning paths from a knowledge graph extracted from the passages, so the gold answer is fixed by the path and question structure/complexity is controllable.

Abstention is made a discrete supervised label committed to before the answer, and refusal examples are constructed by removing evidence until a strong extractive reader can no longer recover the gold answer.
~3.25M QA pairs (~8B Qwen3 tokens): 2.78M single-hop, 262k multi-hop single-context, 165k multi-hop multi-context, 43k abstain; distractors consume 35-75% of tokens.
Single-hop: Wikipedia paragraphs chunked, 10 QA pairs per gold paragraph via gpt-oss-120B, distractors mined from linked child pages by TF-IDF cosine similarity (top 20), then LLM-as-judge filtering.

Multi-hop: KGs extracted from MuSiQue train gold+distractor passages using Wikontic (Wikidata ontology constraints) with gpt-oss-120B; SPARQL templates sample DRAGOn-style question types (simple, 2-hop set/multi-hop/condition, 3-hop bamboo).
Refusal cases built with a SQuAD-finetuned DeBERTa: if it cannot recover the answer from a reduced gold context, the example becomes unanswerable.

Traces generated by Qwen3.5-27B with native thinking disabled; filtered by section-format completeness, exact-match to gold, Qwen3-4B verifier for near-misses, and overthinking filters (>1,256 reasoning tokens or >10 hedging markers like 'Wait'/'Alternatively').
Base models Qwen3-0.6B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base (chosen over Gemma3 and SmolLM3 on a held-out QA slice at fixed compute).

SFT with loss on response tokens only; prompt = question plus shuffled numbered source passages, delimited by new special tokens whose embeddings are initialized from the mean of their name's subword embeddings; identical format at train and eval time.
Multi-hop subsets oversampled 3x per epoch vs 1x for single-hop; a curriculum schedule (single-hop first) was also tried.
~9e9 training tokens, 1 epoch, AdamW, peak LR 1e-4 cosine, seq len 6,144, FSDP on 8xH100 (17h and 28h).
Multi-hop: HotpotQA (7,405) and MuSiQue (2,417) with 10 supplied sources (In-Acc), TAT-QA (906, span and multi-span only, F1).
Faithfulness: ConFiQA counterfactual-context subsets QA/MR/MC (In-Acc against counterfactual answer plus Memorization Ratio M_R).
Refusal: MuSiQue-Un with 10 sources, Refusal Accuracy for emitting 'Not enough information'.
Qwen3 0.6B-32B and Gemma3 1B-27B instruct checkpoints, SmolLM3-3B (thinking and non-thinking modes reported where available).
Pleias-RAG-1.2B as the directly task-specialized context-QA baseline.

key_findings.finding: Task-specialized mid-training yields the best context faithfulness and lowest parametric-knowledge leakage of any model evaluated, including ones up to 32B parameters.
key_findings.evidence: ConFiQA In-Acc 79.9 (0.6B) and 81.4 (1.7B) with memorization ratio 5.2 and 5.0, versus best baselines Qwen3-8B 77.6 In-Acc / 6.9 M_R (thinking) and Gemma3-27B 73.0 / 8.0; mid-training cuts M_R from 12.7 (8.3 thinking) for Qwen3-1.7B to 5.0.

key_findings.finding: Calibrated abstention is learnable at sub-2B scale, reaching refusal accuracy comparable to 8B+ general-purpose models.
key_findings.evidence: MuSiQue-Un R-Acc 86.9 (0.6B) and 87.2 (1.7B) vs Qwen3-1.7B 54.7 (82.8 thinking), Qwen3-4B 64.1 (84.0), Qwen3-8B 90.7, Gemma3-27B 71.1.

key_findings.finding: On multi-hop reasoning the compact models match or beat general-purpose models 2-6x larger but do not fully close the gap to 8B+ models on Wikipedia multi-hop QA.
key_findings.evidence: OCC-RAG-1.7B: HotpotQA 60.9, MuSiQue 38.2, TAT-QA F1 81.0 (best overall on TAT-QA); it beats Gemma3-4B (55.8/30.1/65.3) and non-thinking Qwen3-4B on MuSiQue/TAT-QA, while Qwen3-32B reaches 70.9/49.7 on HotpotQA/MuSiQue.

key_findings.finding: The KG-conditioned multi-hop generation pipeline is what separates OCC-RAG from the prior context-QA-specialized baseline.
key_findings.evidence: Against Pleias-RAG-1.2B (same trace format, no multi-hop generation stage), OCC-RAG-0.6B gains 21.6 points on MuSiQue (36.6 vs 15.0), 42.6 on ConFiQA In-Acc (79.9 vs 37.3), 66.6 F1 on TAT-QA (75.0 vs 8.4), and 65 points on refusal.
